events.name: Mysterious Chest
events.intro: A heavy chest sits alone in the grass. It rattles once.

success.text: Treasure! It was full of shiny things.

failure.text: A Pokémon bursts out of the chest!

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Shady Dealer
events.intro: "Psst. Trade me one of yours and I'll give you something… stronger."

success.text: He hands over a Poké Ball with a wink.

events.name: Lost Pokémon
events.intro: A small Pokémon is crying by the path. Its trainer is nowhere to be seen.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Training Session
events.intro: A Black Belt offers to train your lead Pokémon.

success.text: Your lead grits its teeth and grows stronger!
A calm session. Your lead trusts you more.

events.name: Department Store Sale
events.intro: A pop-up stall: "Everything must go!"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Vitamin Seller
events.intro: A man in sunglasses opens a crate of unlabeled bottles.

failure.text: They tasted awful. Your Pokémon sulk.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Fight or Flight
events.intro: A strong Pokémon guards something glowing.

success.text: You slip by and grab the item!

events.name: Berry Patch
events.intro: A berry bush, heavy with fruit. Something is munching on it.

events.name: Wandering Breeder
events.intro: A breeder offers to look after one of your Pokémon for a while.

success.text: It comes back glowing and happy, with a new trick.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Mysterious Challengers
events.intro: Three trainers on pedestals. "Pick your opponent!"

success.text: The strongest of them steps down.

events.name: Sleeping Giant
events.intro: A huge Snorlax is asleep across the path.

success.text: It munches happily and rolls aside. Something fell from its fur.

events.name: Fortune Teller
events.intro: "The cards know who waits at the gym…"

success.text: She describes the gym leader's whole team.
You work it out from the signs.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Department Store Haggle
events.intro: Price tags flip to red as a clerk waves you over.

success.text: You talk the price right down.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Shady Vitamin Dealer
events.intro: A crate of bottles. Some labels are… spelled wrong.

success.text: You spot the fakes and pick a real one.

events.name: Black Market
events.intro: A curtain parts. Goods no shop would sell.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Travelling Collector
events.intro: A collector peers at your Bag through a glass case.

success.text: A mystery item, wrapped in paper.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Pokémon Salesman
events.intro: "A Magikarp on a cushion! Only ₽500! It's a secret kind!"

failure.text: "Secret? It's a fish." You buy it anyway.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Bargain Bin
events.intro: A janitor tips over a bin of odds and ends.

success.text: Something good was buried in there!
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Chef's Tasting
events.intro: Steaming plates line a roadside table.

success.text: You win the cook-off! Free berries.

failure.text: Burnt. You help with the dishes.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Item Pawnshop
events.intro: A maid sits at a ledger. "Pawn something?"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Ticket Tout
events.intro: "Ticket to a secret stop? Real, I swear."

success.text: It was real! Every "?" on this stage is revealed.
He hands it over for free.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Charm Peddler
events.intro: Lanterns sway over a cart of charms.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Mega Bazaar
events.intro: A shopfront glittering with strange stones.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Winstrate Family
events.intro: A whole family lines up. "Beat us all, back to back!"

success.text: The family sends out their best!
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: A Trainer's Test
events.intro: "Battle me with one Pokémon, and I'll teach it something."

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Double Trouble
events.intro: Twins hold hands. "We battle together!"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Dojo Challenge
events.intro: A Black Belt bows. "Spar, or meditate?"

failure.text: You take a beating, but learn.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Rival Rematch
events.intro: Your rival runs up, out of breath. "Battle! Now!"

events.name: Battle Tower Floor
events.intro: Two conductors stand at a lift door. "All aboard for the next floor!"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Youngster's Shorts
events.intro: "Like my shorts? They're comfy and easy to wear!"

success.text: He's so happy he gives you a Rare Candy.

events.name: Ace Trainer Bet
events.intro: An Ace Trainer flips a coin. "Bet on our battle?"

events.name: Gym Scout
events.intro: A guide points at the gym. "Want to know what's inside?"

success.text: You learn the leader's whole team.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Pokéathlon
events.intro: A track, hurdles and a cheering crowd.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Contest Hall
events.intro: Spotlights sweep the stage. "Beauty, Cool or Cute?"

success.text: You pick up a few tips.

events.name: Slumbering Snorlax
events.intro: Snoring shakes the ground.

success.text: It rolls over and drops something.

events.name: Glowing Guardian
events.intro: A strong Pokémon stands over a glowing item.

success.text: It trades the item for a snack.

events.name: Berries Abound
events.intro: A berry tree shakes with Pokémon.

events.name: Lost at Sea
events.intro: A swimmer waves from a drifting raft.

success.text: Safe! They give you a gift.

failure.text: The current is too strong. You barely make it.

events.name: Fiery Fallout
events.intro: Ash rains down. Fire Pokémon sleep in the warm haze.

success.text: The ash clears. Your party is tired.
Steam! A rare Fire Pokémon wants to come with you.

events.name: Uncommon Breed
events.intro: A strangely coloured Pokémon is eating quietly.

events.name: Pokémon Stampede
events.intro: A herd thunders towards you!

success.text: The herd parts around you. One stays.
You leap aside and catch one's eye.
You hide, but get trampled a bit.

events.name: Swarm
events.intro: Dozens of the same Pokémon fill the field.

events.name: Injured Pokémon
events.intro: A fainted wild Pokémon lies in the grass.

success.text: It wakes and nuzzles you. It wants to come along!
You catch it while it's down.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Egg Nest
events.intro: An unguarded nest holds one egg.

success.text: It hatches right away into a baby!

events.name: Legendary Shadow
events.intro: A huge silhouette moves in the fog. The air goes still.

failure.text: The shadow fades into the fog.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Fishing Spot
events.intro: "Borrow a rod? Old, Good or Super!"

events.name: Team Rocket Ambush
events.intro: A net drops from the trees! "Prepare for trouble!"

success.text: They grab the cash and blast off.
"The police are right behind me!" They flee, dropping something.

events.name: Team Aqua Dig
events.intro: Team Aqua grunts are digging up the shore.

events.name: Team Magma Heist
events.intro: Team Magma surrounds a smoking crate.

success.text: While they argue, you take the crate.

events.name: Galactic Survey
events.intro: A Galactic grunt waves a scanner. "Mind if I scan your party?"

success.text: "Then I'll take the data by force!"
You peek at their readings. Interesting!

events.name: Plasma Liberation
events.intro: "Liberate your Pokémon!" A Plasma grunt waves a banner.

success.text: "You're a prisoner of your own Pokémon!"

choices.label: Give them money for their cause

success.text: They pay you back double, oddly.

events.name: Flare Fashion
events.intro: Two grunts in red suits strike a pose.

events.name: Skull Squad
events.intro: Team Skull grunts spray graffiti. "Yo, what you lookin' at?"

success.text: Your rhymes win! They pay up.

failure.text: They laugh you off the stage.

events.name: Yell Fans
events.intro: Team Yell blocks the road with signs and noise.

success.text: Out-yelled! They let you through, impressed.

events.name: Star Squad Raid
events.intro: A Starmobile revs outside a Team Star base.

events.name: Rainbow Rocket
events.intro: A portal crackles. A villain boss steps through.

failure.text: The portal sucks something from your Bag.

events.name: Shadow Triad
events.intro: Three figures appear in a puff of smoke.

events.name: Ghetsis's Offer
events.intro: "Power, child. Take it."

events.name: Pickpocket
events.intro: Someone bumps into you and runs off with something!

success.text: You catch them and get it back, plus a bit extra.

events.name: Fake Nurse
events.intro: A nurse offers to heal your team. Her smile is… off.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Pokémon Center Lady
events.intro: "Would you like me to heal your Pokémon?"

events.name: Breeder's Visit
events.intro: A breeder with a basket. "I can look after one for a bit."

success.text: It comes back happier and a little stronger.

events.name: Professor's Lab
events.intro: A professor waves you into a lab full of machines.

events.name: Gift from Mom
events.intro: A parcel addressed to you. "From Mom."

success.text: Money, medicine and a note: "Eat your vegetables."
You put it away. It's heavy… a Rare Candy!

events.name: Ranger Rescue
events.intro: A Ranger with a Capture Styler needs help freeing a trapped Pokémon.

success.text: Freed! It chooses to come with you.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Daycare Couple
events.intro: An old couple at a fence. "We'll raise one for you!"

success.text: It's grown while you were away!
They found an Egg! It hatches in your arms.

events.name: Lost Child
events.intro: Two preschoolers are crying.

events.name: Nurse Joy's Clinic
events.intro: A small clinic with a friendly doctor.

events.name: Kind Hiker
events.intro: A hiker offers trail mix.

success.text: You share a snack. Good vibes.

events.name: Wishing Well
events.intro: A stone well. Coins glint at the bottom.

events.name: Game Corner
events.intro: Slot reels spin under flashing lights.

success.text: You trade coins for a prize.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Rattling Chest
events.intro: Another chest. This one rattles a lot.

failure.text: A Mimic! It was a Pokémon all along!

success.text: You hear a Pokémon inside and leave it. A coin rolls out.

events.name: Coin Flip Gambler
events.intro: "Heads or tails? Double or nothing!"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Lottery Booth
events.intro: A drum of numbered balls. "Try your luck!"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Card Shark
events.intro: A harlequin shuffles a deck.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Crystal Ball
events.intro: A medium gazes into a crystal ball.

success.text: The gym leader's team appears in the glass.

events.name: Roulette of Fate
events.intro: A clown spins a giant wheel.

success.text: Big win: money and a Rare Candy!
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Pokémon Prize Wheel
events.intro: An idol presents a wheel of Pokémon.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Punching Bag
events.intro: A punching bag swings in the breeze.

events.name: Move Tutor
events.intro: A sage sits by an old scroll.

success.text: Your lead learns from the scroll.

events.name: Move Forgetter
events.intro: A teacher at a chalkboard. "Need to forget something?"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Library
events.intro: Quiet shelves, full of Pokédex entries.

events.name: Gym Rat
events.intro: A triathlete waves from a bike.

events.name: Meditation Shrine
events.intro: A psychic floats above a mat.

events.name: Dragon's Den
events.intro: A Dragon Tamer holds out a gleaming scale.

success.text: You pass! The scale is yours.

events.name: Expert Breeder
events.intro: "I can teach your Pokémon an egg move."

success.text: A new trick from its parents!
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Weird Dream
events.intro: The screen fades. A ghost floats in your dream.

success.text: You wake with a gift in your hand.

failure.text: A nightmare. Your team sleeps badly.

events.name: Ruins of Alph
events.intro: Torchlight flickers over a stone puzzle.

success.text: The wall opens. An Unown floats out!

events.name: Haunted House
events.intro: The lights flicker. Something giggles upstairs.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Time-Travel Rift
events.intro: A glowing rift hangs in the air.

events.name: Meteorite Crash
events.intro: A crater, still smoking.

events.name: Mirage Island
events.intro: A shimmering island appears offshore.

success.text: A Pokémon of legend… in a strange form!
It fades. You feel lucky to have seen it.

events.name: Abandoned Lab
events.intro: Broken machines and scattered notes.

events.name: Shrine Maiden
events.intro: A shrine maiden sweeps beneath a red gate.

success.text: Money… and a chill down your spine.

events.name: Spooky Festival
events.intro: Jack-o'-lanterns light a parade.

events.name: Ghost Train
events.intro: A dark train waits at an empty platform.

success.text: A strange journey. You arrive stronger.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Strange Signal
events.intro: An antenna sparks. Something is calling.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Ash's Training
events.intro: "Hey! Wanna battle? Pikachu's all fired up!"

success.text: You learn a lot from him.

events.name: Champion Lunch
events.intro: A Champion waves you over to a picnic table.

events.name: Red on the Mountain
events.intro: A silent trainer stands in the snow.

events.name: Elesa's Photoshoot
events.intro: Cameras flash. "Strike a pose!"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Iono's Stream
events.intro: "Hey hey! You're live on my stream!"

events.name: Kahili's Golf
events.intro: "Care for a round?"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Professor's Time Machine
events.intro: A humming machine. "Shall we see the past… or future?"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Giovanni's Offer
events.intro: "Join Team Rocket. I reward loyalty."

success.text: He hands you a fat envelope.

events.name: Lillie and Nebby
events.intro: A girl clutches a bag. "Please, help us!"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Penny's Hack
events.intro: "I can… improve your Bag. Probably."

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Pokéfan Meetup
events.intro: Pokéfans gather to show off their favourites.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Fire-Breather's Show
events.intro: A Fire-Breather lights up the night.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Surf Rescue
events.intro: A surfer is caught in a rip current.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Flower Garden
events.intro: An Aroma Lady tends a bright garden.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Power Plant Fault
events.intro: Sparks fly from a broken generator.

success.text: Fixed! An Electric Pokémon was hiding inside.

events.name: Frozen Lake
events.intro: A frozen lake glitters. Something shines in the ice.

success.text: You grab it on the way!

events.name: Street Brawl
events.intro: Two trainers are about to fight.

events.name: Toxic Swamp
events.intro: Purple bubbles rise from a swamp.

success.text: A Poison Pokémon follows you out!
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Fossil Dig
events.intro: A hiker hands you a shovel.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Sky Race
events.intro: Bird Keepers line up for a race.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Mind Reader
events.intro: "Guess my card."

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Bug-Catching Contest
events.intro: "Catch the biggest bug!"

failure.text: A small one. It joins anyway.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Cave-In
events.intro: Rubble blocks the tunnel.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Graveyard Vigil
events.intro: Candles flicker over old graves.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Dragon Shrine
events.intro: An elder asks you a question about kindness.

events.name: Back-Alley Deal
events.intro: "Want something nobody else has?"

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Junkyard
events.intro: Piles of scrap metal.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Fairy Tea Party
events.intro: A tea party with Fairy Pokémon.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Pokémon Center
events.intro: A small Pokémon Center with a shop counter.

events.name: Berry Tree
events.intro: A lone berry tree.

events.name: Treasure Cache
events.intro: A buried box sticks out of the dirt.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Training Ground
events.intro: Tracks, weights and targets.

events.name: Villain Hideout
events.intro: A secret base hums behind a poster.

success.text: You grab a crate and run.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Rest Spot: Meadow
events.intro: A quiet meadow. Time to spend with your lead Pokémon.

success.text: Munch munch. It loves you more.

events.name: Rest Spot: Training Field
events.intro: An open field, perfect for practice.

failure.text: Just mud, but it had fun.

events.name: Rest Spot: Photo Corner
events.intro: A scenic spot with a camera stand.

events.name: Oak's Letter: The Sky Trio
events.intro: The letter leads to a cliff. Wings beat overhead: a legendary bird of Kanto.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: S.S. Ticket: The Ferry
events.intro: The S.S. Anne sounds its horn. "All aboard for the gym city!"

success.text: You step off right beside the gym, and the ship's shop is open.
The deck shop has fair prices.

events.name: Card Key: Silph Doors
events.intro: A Silph Co. door clicks open. A crate of prototypes sits inside.

events.name: Secret Key: Hidden Volcano
events.intro: The Secret Key opens a gate on Cinnabar's slope. Something hot stirs.

success.text: Old notes and a pouch of coins.

events.name: Lift Key: Rocket Hideout
events.intro: The lift drops to the Rocket hideout's vault floor.

events.name: Basement Key: Old Tunnels
events.intro: Under the Goldenrod basement, the tunnels rumble.

success.text: A rare Ground or Rock Pokémon!

events.name: Storage Key: The Warehouse
events.intro: Boxes from floor to ceiling. Some are labelled for you.

events.name: Suite Key: Luxury Suite
events.intro: A suite with soft beds and a view. Your team flops down.

events.name: Works Key: Power Plant
events.intro: The old power plant crackles. Sparks dance between the coils.

events.name: Room 1 Key: Abandoned Ship
events.intro: Cabin 1 creaks open. A dusty trunk sits under the porthole.

events.name: Room 2 Key: Abandoned Ship
events.intro: A sailor in cabin 2 jumps up. "A battle! Winner takes double!"

success.text: The sailor sends out his team!

events.name: Room 4 Key: Abandoned Ship
events.intro: Cabin 4 is cold. A shadow slides across the wall.

success.text: You slam the door. Your heart races.

events.name: Room 6 Key: The Scanner
events.intro: In cabin 6 you find a Scanner. A collector on deck offers a trade for it.

success.text: The collector hands over a treasure.

events.name: Galactic Key: Veilstone HQ
events.intro: Team Galactic's warehouse door slides open.

success.text: A grateful Pokémon follows you out.

events.name: Magma Emblem: The Hideout
events.intro: The emblem opens Team Magma's volcano base. Deep below, Groudon sleeps.

events.name: Red Chain: Spear Pillar
events.intro: The Red Chain glows at the top of Mt. Coronet. Time and space twist.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: Eon Ticket: Southern Island
events.intro: A small island. Two shapes circle above the tree.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: MysticTicket: Navel Rock
events.intro: Navel Rock. At the top a rainbow; at the bottom, deep water.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: AuroraTicket: Birth Island
events.intro: A triangle on Birth Island shifts as you step close.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: Old Sea Map: Faraway Island
events.intro: Tall grass on Faraway Island. Something pink giggles.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: Liberty Pass: Liberty Garden
events.intro: Under the lighthouse, a tiny Pokémon with a V on its head waits.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: Azure Flute: Hall of Origin
events.intro: You play the Azure Flute. Stairs of light rise into the sky.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: Dark Stone: Zekrom
events.intro: The Dark Stone crackles with black lightning.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: Light Stone: Reshiram
events.intro: The Light Stone burns white-hot in your hands.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: Magma Stone: Stark Mountain
events.intro: Deep in Stark Mountain, the lava bubbles around a steel shape.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: Rainbow Wing: Bell Tower
events.intro: The bells ring. A rainbow bird lands on the roof.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: Silver Wing: Whirl Islands
events.intro: Whirlpools roar. A silver shape rises from the sea.

success.text: It watches you leave. You feel blessed.

events.name: Tri-Pass: Sevii Ferry
events.intro: The Seagallop ferry can take you to one of three islands.

success.text: A rare Pokémon in the grass!

events.name: Rainbow Pass: All the Islands
events.intro: The Rainbow Pass covers every island. Shop, rest, then explore!

success.text: Market, springs, and now a rare Pokémon!

events.name: Contest Pass: Super Contest
events.intro: The Contest Pass gets you on stage. The crowd waits.

failure.text: A slip, but the crowd liked it.

events.name: Lost Property Office
events.intro: "Nobody ever comes back for these," the clerk sighs, waving at a shelf of keys and tickets.

success.text: One of these must open something.
"They say a ticket to a faraway island turned up once…"

events.name: The Old Collector
events.intro: An old man keeps a case of rare tickets and stones. "Prove yourself and pick one."

success.text: He hands you an old sea chart.

events.name: Ruins Dig Site
events.intro: Researchers dig at ancient ruins. Two stones glint in the dirt, one dark and one light.

events.name: The Lake Trio's Gift
events.intro: Three lights rise from three lakes and meet over your head. A red chain falls into your hand.

events.name: The Flute Maker
events.intro: A craftsman plays a blue flute. "This one opens the sky. It costs a lot."

success.text: A bell for a legendary bird.

events.name: Shady Emblem Seller
events.intro: "Psst. Want a Magma Emblem? Or a Galactic key? No questions asked."

events.name: Professor's Errand
events.intro: "Could you take this letter to an old friend? It might lead somewhere special."

events.name: It Doesn't Want to Fight…
events.intro: A wild Pokémon trembles in the grass. It is frightened, or guarding something. It does not want to fight.

success.text: It fights back with everything it has!
You retreat. It watches you go, calmer.
It eats the berry and relaxes. It leaves you a small gift.
You find its hidden nest and learn something about its kind.

failure.text: It startles and bolts into the grass.

events.name: It Saw What You Did…
events.intro: A Pokémon at the edge of the path has been watching you for a long time. It saw how you treated others on this road.

success.text: It remembers your kindness and shows you a hidden cache.
It remembers your cruelty. It is not alone!
It cannot say, but it follows you for a while and warms to you.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: This Place Remembers…
events.intro: You have been somewhere like this before. The ground, the air and the old stones seem to remember the battles fought here.

success.text: Something was left behind from an earlier battle.

failure.text: Only dust and the echo of old footsteps.

success.text: The tracks lead you to a quieter path.
Your team feels the history of this place and grows closer.
